Parent Connect — our #1 selling point

Parents see their child's school life — live

Most software just stores records. SchoolSense keeps parents connected the moment things happen. That trust is why parents insist their school stays on SchoolSense.

  • Instant push notifications — every activity — attendance, homework, marks, fees, fines and events — the moment it happens.

  • Live attendance — the moment roll call happens, not at day-end.

  • Homework & marks instantly — as soon as the teacher posts them.

  • Fee invoices, receipts & fines — always available — no "I paid, where is the receipt?".

  • Emergency alerts — urgent school messages reach parents in seconds — not by evening.

  • Notices, events & holidays — delivered instantly, nothing lost in the school bag.

  • Complaints with tracking — raise an issue, follow every reply until it is closed.

  • Today's timetable — no morning confusion about which books to pack.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Do we need a computer expert at our school to use SchoolSense?

No. SchoolSense is designed for everyday users — big buttons, simple screens and plain language. Our team does the initial setup and trains your staff for free. If your staff can use WhatsApp, they can use SchoolSense.

How much does it cost?

The regular price is ₹49 per student per month, which covers every feature. As a launch offer, new schools pay just ₹10 per student per month. Billing is monthly and only for enrolled students — no yearly lock-in, no setup fee.

Are all features really included in this price?

Yes. Timetable, attendance, homework, exams & marksheets, notices, complaints, fee management, alumni management and auto-generated certificates (TC, Character Certificate and more) are all included in the base price. Only special on-demand features you may request later are quoted separately.

Can parents use it on a basic smartphone?

Yes. Parents get updates in a simple mobile-friendly view that works in any phone browser — no expensive phone needed. Everything is shown in an easy timeline: attendance, homework, marks, fees and notices.

Is our school data safe?

Yes. Your data is protected with bank-grade encryption — encrypted in transit and at rest — and strictly isolated per school: no other school can ever see your data, and one school’s records are never mixed with another’s. Passwords are hashed so even our team cannot read them, every important action is audit-logged, and regular backups protect your records.

How long does it take to start?

Most schools go live within a week. We set up your classes, sections, subjects and fee structure, train your teachers and admin staff, and stay available while you settle in. Setup and training are free.

Can you build a feature our school specifically needs?

Yes. Every school works a little differently, so we build custom features on request — special reports, formats or workflows. Tell us what you need and we will scope it honestly before building anything. Your base plan price never changes because of it.
